prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a vast stone courtyard of the Forbidden City with a standard-height palace gate, marble steps with waist-high balustrades, empty of visitors, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Turkish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, natural soft black hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver square-sided cowbell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin small flared temple bell, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a copper round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver hair ornaments. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide; a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle, the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape; a full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense engraved floral facets filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet.
